items.summary: Stay hungry, stay foolish. Absolute legend Jensen Huang (@JensenHuang) For my first post, I’m sharing a letter @NVIDIA signed on why open models matter. AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country. Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.
